name: The 39 Steps
source: Prepare to experience the original man-on-the-run thriller in a completely new way. Be transported back to 1914 London, where Richard Hannay finds himself framed for a murder he didn't commit. Now he must escape the Capital and stay alive long enough to solve the riddle of The 39 Steps. There are secrets to be discovered, locations to be explored and - above all - an incredible tale to be told in this ground-breaking interactive novel.
translation: 准备好以全新的方式体验这部经典的亡命惊悚故事吧。回到1914年的伦敦，理查德·汉内发现自己被诬陷犯了一桩他没有犯下的谋杀案。现在他必须逃离首都，并活到足够长的时间来解开“三十九级台阶”之谜。在这部开创性的互动小说中，有待发现的秘密、待探索的地点，以及——最重要的——一个不可思议的故事。
